RTB - Spoke with Casey and her team. The IPT Lead that the project engineers will be communicating with is Jarrod Hargis (He is over all of the vendors). They need Project Engineers in 4 location over 4 different Vendors. 

Aerohead - Los Alamitos, CA - They Build the core stage of the Feed Lines. Need someone with Structural Feed lines and NDT Experience. Experience in Building Hardware. Has some experience in Stress Fracture nondestructive evaluation. Just need to be able to speak stress. Mechanical Engineering background working with Stress and Fracture Engineers.

General Dynamics - Lincoln NB - They do the COPV's (Composite Overwrap Pressure Vessels) of the upper stage and core stage of the rocket. COPV's are a metallic tank wrapped in composite fibers. They hold the helium on the space  craft. Want someone with Mechanical/propulsion engineering background that has pressure vessel exp. 

Nu Space - Long Beach, CA - They do a separate tank for the exploration upper stage. This is what's called a Hydrazine Mono Prop System. Some one with Mono Propellent Propulsion System background, Hypergolics, or Hydrazine. Someone with Mechanical Engineering with Propulsion Satellite experience.

Pacific Scientific (Pac SCi) - Chandler, AZ - Building the Core Stage and EUS (Exploration Upper Stage) of the Safe and Arm mechanism. This is a device that arms the rocket if it is over land so it can explode before it hits land. It's a component that takes the aircraft from a safe position to an Armed position. Need Someone with Pyrotechnical system Background or Ordinance Position background. Someone with Electromechanical device experience. 

She also connect me with Anthony Hankinson (Program Quality Manager) and Alyssa Helwig (Senior Manager, Space Launch System Production Engineering) for there Michoud Assembly Facility. They need people over there because of the recent attrition they have gone through. NotesActivityReport_Main,Atlanta,Matt Capelluto,8/5/2025,Contact,Appointment,Neha Chang,New Lead,"Leidos, SSA, ITSSC: met with Neha this morning, learned a little about her background.
